set.body:
Plan:
1. Add renderer-neutral core tests for scalar/unit/scene/axis invariants that every backend relies on.
2. Add SVG backend primitive rendering tests for lines, tick segments, labels, point shapes, rectangles, groups, viewports, style attributes, and unsupported unit errors.
3. Add scene-level golden fixtures for axis-only and mixed-primitives SVG output to catch ordering, escaping, attributes, and formatting drift.
4. Verify behavior on both JVM and Scala.js with graphicsJVM/test, graphicsJS/test, graphicsSvgJVM/test, and graphicsSvgJS/test.
Acceptance:
- Basic primitives needed for axes and small plots are covered structurally and by exact SVG goldens.
- Unsupported behavior returns typed errors.
- Focused JVM and JS suites are green.
set.title: Harden graphics primitive and SVG behavior tests
